(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyze the network data and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action includes at least one of adjusting an access control list (ACL) to block the malicious network threat or logically separating the IP address or domain from a network.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, wherein the notification is generated in response to detecting the malicious network threat.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network data and identifying a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action includes at least one of adjusting an access control list (ACL) to block the malicious network threat or logically separating the IP address or domain from a network.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, wherein the notification is generated in response to detecting the malicious network threat.
